name: Lower third
alt: Lower third: a name on a white plate with a role on a blue tag below it, in the lower left.

name: Countdown
alt: Countdown: a small white plate in the top right corner with the round, the time 1:00 and a blue timer bar.

states.name: Warning
states.alt: Countdown in its last seconds: the plate has a red outline and the timer bar is almost empty.

states.name: Paused
states.alt: Countdown after Pause: a dark Paused badge under the clock.

states.name: Time up
states.alt: Countdown at zero: the clock reads 0:00 and a red Time's up badge shows under it.

name: Show clock
alt: Show clock: a full dark screen with the words The show starts in above a large white clock reading 5:00.

name: Quiz
alt: Quiz: a question on a white bar above four answers lettered A to D on blue tiles.

states.name: Answer selected
states.alt: Quiz after Select answer: answer B has a blue outline.

states.name: Locked in
states.alt: Quiz after Lock it in: a blue Locked in badge above the question.

states.name: Correct revealed
states.alt: Quiz after Reveal correct: answer B turns green and the other answers are greyed.

name: Game rules
alt: Game rules: a full dark screen headed How to play with five numbered rules on white bars.

name: Be back soon
alt: Be back soon: a full dark screen with Be right back in large type and a short line below.

name: Scoreboard, 2 players
alt: Scoreboard for two players: Home and Away names on white plates either side of two blue scores at the top.

states.name: Point for team 1
states.alt: Scoreboard after +1 for the home team: a blue +1 point flash under its name.

name: Scoreboard, 4 players
alt: Scoreboard for four players: four names in a row along the top, each with its score on a blue tile.

states.name: Point for player 3
states.alt: Scoreboard after +1 for the third player: a blue flash under that player.

name: Winner
alt: Winner: a white card in the centre naming the winner, a blue Winner badge on top and confetti around it.

name: End credits
alt: End credits: the show title on a dark screen, then each role in blue above its names in white, centred.

name: End credits, two columns
alt: End credits in two columns: the show title, then roles on the left and their names on the right.

name: Join card
alt: Join card: a white card in the lower left with a QR code, the words Join the show and a line asking viewers to scan the code to vote and ask a question.

name: Live vote
alt: Live vote while voting is open: a large white board with the question, four options with blue bars and a green Vote now badge.

states.name: Result
states.alt: Live vote after Show result: each option's bar is drawn to its share and its percentage shows beside it.

states.name: Winner called
states.alt: Live vote after Call the winner: the leading option is outlined in green.

name: Vote results
alt: Vote results while voting is open: a white side panel with the question, four options with bars, a green Voting open badge and the vote count.

states.name: Closed with result
states.alt: Vote results after voting closed and Show result: the badge is gone, the count line says voting closed and each option shows its percentage.

states.name: Winner called
states.alt: Vote results after Call the winner: the leading option is outlined in green.

name: Message
alt: Message: a viewer's name on a blue tag above a white plate holding their message, in the lower left.

name: Title
alt: Title, navy: the show title in large navy type on a yellow band, with an episode line below.

name: Lower third, navy
alt: Lower third, navy: a name in white and a role in yellow on a navy plate with a yellow edge, in the lower left.

name: Ticker
alt: Ticker: a navy bar along the bottom of the screen with a yellow News label and one line of story.

name: Quiz, navy
alt: Quiz, navy: a question on a navy bar above four answers lettered A to D on yellow tiles.

states.name: Answer selected
states.alt: Navy quiz after Select answer: answer B has a yellow outline.

states.name: Locked in
states.alt: Navy quiz after Lock it in: a yellow Locked in badge above the question.

states.name: Correct revealed
states.alt: Navy quiz after Reveal correct: answer B turns green and the wrong answers turn red.

name: Scoreboard
alt: Scoreboard, navy: Home and Away on navy plates either side of two yellow scores at the top.

states.name: Point for team 1
states.alt: Navy scoreboard after +1 for the home team: a yellow +1 point flash under its name.

states.name: Point for team 2
states.alt: Navy scoreboard after +1 for the away team: a yellow +1 point flash under its name.

name: Countdown, navy
alt: Countdown, navy: a navy panel with the show title in yellow, Starting in, a large 05:00 and a yellow bar.

states.name: Warning
states.alt: Navy countdown near the end: the panel has a red outline.

states.name: Paused
states.alt: Navy countdown after Pause: a Paused label under the clock.

states.name: Time up
states.alt: Navy countdown at zero: a yellow Starting now label under the clock.

name: Standings
alt: Standings: a navy panel headed Weekend standings with three ranked rows, each a position, a name and points.

name: Live vote, navy
alt: Live vote, navy: a navy panel with the question, three options with yellow bars and percentages, and the vote count.

name: Goal meter
alt: Goal meter: a navy panel headed Community fund with a large percentage and a yellow progress bar.

name: Pop-up alert
alt: Pop-up alert: a navy plate with a yellow edge in the top left, thanking a supporter by name.

name: Survey board
alt: Survey board: a navy panel with a question and three answers with their points, and a total below.

name: Stepped list
alt: Stepped list: a navy panel headed Three places to visit with three entries on bars.

name: Lineup
alt: Lineup: a navy panel headed Tonight's guests with three guest names on bars.

name: Puzzle board
alt: Puzzle board: a navy panel headed The word round with a category and a row of letter tiles.

name: Reveal
alt: Reveal: a navy panel headed The final figure with a cover showing a question mark.

name: Bingo caller
alt: Bingo caller: a navy panel with numbers 1 to 15 on tiles and the latest call in large yellow type.

name: End credits, navy
alt: End credits, navy: the show title in yellow, then roles in yellow above names in white, centred, running past the bottom of the frame.

name: Switch
alt: Switch: a navy card with a show title, Coming up and a line of text, above a yellow sponsor tag.

name: Choice
alt: Choice: a navy card with a show title and one line of text above a yellow Live status tag.

name: Clock
alt: Clock: a large white 12:00 on a dark plate with a yellow top edge, in the centre.

name: Score and clock
alt: Score and clock: a navy bar at the top with Home and Away, two yellow scores and a clock reading 12:00.

name: Editable end credits
alt: Editable end credits: the show title on a dark screen, then each role in yellow above its names in white.
